person_updates.identity_evidence: The P-1 index grade establishes civilian professional or administrative status but supplies no middle initial, private identifier, note, or office. Exact-name official, CIA, employer, obituary, directory, newspaper, institutional, and archival checks did not resolve the indexed identity.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 76 for identity, employing office, role, and employment chronology.
